name: jump start
description: A jump from the floor to catch a small hold or campus rung and hold it still. It trains the fingers to grip hard the instant they touch a hold.
instructions: Pick a small target hold or rung that you can only just reach with a jump.
Stand below it with your feet on the floor, holding a start hold with one hand if you like.
Bend your knees and jump, catching the target with your free hand or with both hands.
Hold the catch still for 2 to 3 seconds with your shoulders engaged.
Let go and land on a padded floor with bent knees.
Rest fully between attempts and stop when your catches get weaker.
